rate_table_note: Rates are in subsection (1) of the rule, for decreasing gross coverage (paragraphs (a) and (b)) and level term (paragraph (c)). Dismemberment is at most 10% of these rates; accelerated death benefit prima facie rates are $.03 to $.08 per $100 per year (paragraph (f)). The rates assume coverage to age 71. The saved file is the Word document published by flrules.org.
source_title: Rule 69O-163.010, F.A.C., Credit Life Insurance Rates (final adopted version, effective February 11, 2003; flrules.org notice 2791774)
summary: Rates in force: Florida's maximum credit life rates in Rule 69O-163.010, last amended effective February 11, 2003: $0.69 single and $1.21 joint per month per $1,000 of outstanding insured indebtedness; single premium decreasing $0.44 and $0.77, level term $0.82 and $1.43 per $100 per year.
